in_marathi.name: Baburao
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Father of the village
in_marathi.long_meaning: Baburao हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Baburao is derived from the Hindi words ‘Baba’ meaning father and ‘Rao’ meaning chief or ruler. This name signifies a father figure who leads and protects the community.
